facts.question: How many men's Grand Slam singles titles has Novak Djokovic won?
facts.statement: Novak Djokovic has won 24 men's Grand Slam singles titles.
facts.explanation: Djokovic's 24 majors is the men's record.

facts.question: How many French Open singles titles has Rafael Nadal won?
facts.statement: Rafael Nadal has won 14 French Open singles titles.
facts.explanation: Nadal's 14 Roland Garros titles are the most at any single major.

facts.question: How many Wimbledon singles titles has Roger Federer won?
facts.statement: Roger Federer has won 8 Wimbledon singles titles.
facts.explanation: Federer's eight Wimbledon crowns are a men's record at the event.

facts.question: On which surface is Wimbledon played?
facts.explanation: Wimbledon is the only Grand Slam still played on grass.

facts.question: How many Grand Slam singles titles did Serena Williams win?
facts.statement: Serena Williams won 23 Grand Slam singles titles.
facts.explanation: Serena's 23 majors is the Open Era record.

facts.question: How many Grand Slam singles titles did Margaret Court win?
facts.statement: Margaret Court won 24 Grand Slam singles titles.
facts.explanation: Court's 24 majors is the all-time record across both tours.

facts.question: How many Grand Slam tournaments are played each year?
facts.statement: There are 4 Grand Slam tournaments each year.
facts.explanation: The Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open make up the four majors.

facts.question: On which surface is the US Open played?
facts.statement: The US Open is played on hard court.
facts.explanation: The US Open switched from grass to clay in 1975 and to hard court in 1978.

facts.question: How many Grand Slam singles titles did Steffi Graf win?
facts.statement: Steffi Graf won 22 Grand Slam singles titles.
facts.explanation: Graf is the only player to win all four majors at least four times each.

facts.question: How many games were played in the final set of the 2010 Isner-Mahut match?
facts.statement: The final set of the 2010 Isner-Mahut match at Wimbledon lasted 138 games.
facts.explanation: John Isner won the deciding set 70-68 in a match spread over three days.

facts.question: How many Wimbledon singles titles did Martina Navratilova win?
facts.statement: Martina Navratilova won 9 Wimbledon singles titles.
facts.explanation: Navratilova's nine Wimbledon crowns include six in a row from 1982 to 1987.

facts.question: How many points are needed to win a standard tiebreak?
facts.statement: A standard tiebreak is won by the first player to 7 points with a two-point margin.
facts.explanation: If the tiebreak reaches 6-6 it continues until one player leads by two.
